reviewedBy: Codex Eswatini PAYE route and browser QA review
reason: The route now renders annual and monthly values consistently in gross-to-net and net-to-gross modes. PAYE bands, rebate, ENPF deduction, and the forward calculation remain unchanged. A synthetic E600,000 gross fixture still produces E426,971.4 annual net; reverse calculation returns the smallest whole-lilangeni gross that meets an E426,971 annual target. The protected route digest changes because UI state and result rendering changed, not because statutory parameters changed.
